summary: Required rejected/missing credentials are derived from the canonical per-category requirement projection and promoted before optional links/photos only in the effective parent-and-leaf onboarding composition.
The provider hub places actionable required credential repairs before weighted profile strength in the new composition; the corrected legacy composition remains available when the flags are OFF.
The persistent footer, seven resumable wizard keys, six editable sections plus review, optional skip, input validators, media handlers, payout behavior and section return targets are retained.
Provider share and onboarding agreement display names use their dedicated brand identity contexts independent of the onboarding composition leaf.
Deactivation uses the approved duties copy and preserves the existing cancellation/confirmation handler payload. No server, money-safety, deactivation guard, SQL function or migration changes.

selectedCases: ID-WIZARD-SEVEN preserves resumable wizard keys and all six editable sections
ID-SECTION-RETURNS preserves the services return target and defaults other sections to the hub
ID-REQUIRED-DOC-FIRST promotes only actionable canonical required credential repairs
ID-OPTIONAL-SKIP leaves recommended-only work optional and the wizard skip action unchanged
ID-HUB-ACTION-FIRST places actual credential repairs ahead of weighted strength only in the new composition
ID-ONBOARDING-FLAG-PARENTS selects only the effective parent-and-leaf composition
ID-DEACTIVATION-DUTIES-COPY keeps the exact duties copy and existing cancel/confirm payload
